description: Uma equipe unida pela inovação, criatividade e tecnologia, em busca de soluções criativas para os desafios propostos pela NASA Space Apps Challenge.
summary:
ÓRBITA is an interactive platform that transforms the search for Planet X into an accessible and engaging astronomical investigation. Inspired by NASA’s SPHEREx mission, the project combines scientific visualization, space exploration, and game-inspired elements to encourage users to investigate regions of the sky and analyze potential astronomical anomalies.

The initiative aims to bring scientific data closer to the public, making the exploration of the Universe more understandable and engaging. Through an interactive experience, users are encouraged to examine evidence, formulate hypotheses, and understand the limitations of observations, distinguishing possibilities from confirmed discoveries.

By combining technology, science, and storytelling, ÓRBITA seeks to spark scientific curiosity, promote critical thinking, and make astronomical exploration more accessible, helping people better understand the challenges and methods scientists use to investigate our Universe.
details:
ÓRBITA — Planet X Hunters

ÓRBITA is an interactive web platform focused on astronomical exploration, designed to transform the investigation of the Universe into an accessible, immersive, and evidence-based experience. Developed using HTML, CSS, JavaScript/TypeScript, React, and Three.js, the project integrates astronomical APIs and data sources, including SPHEREx, WISE, Gaia, and SIMBAD, bringing users closer to real observations of the Universe.

The platform brings together astronomical exploration tools, options for selecting SPHEREx datasets, such as DR1 and QR3, and time controls that allow users to investigate observations from different periods. Users can compare images, examine potential differences, and record their observations in a dedicated gallery, organizing the results of their investigations. This approach aims to facilitate the analysis of potential moving objects and other anomalies that may warrant further investigation.

To make exploration more engaging, ÓRBITA combines gamification and science communication with space expeditions, 3D visualizations of astronomical systems, and virtual reality (VR) support for exploring three-dimensional environments. Features such as explorer profiles, experience points (XP), anomaly indicators, and collaboration options enhance the experience, encouraging participation and continued investigation.

The project's main strength lies in integrating astronomical exploration, three-dimensional visualization, and interactive features into a browser-accessible platform. Its intended impact is to bring the public closer to scientific data, stimulate curiosity, and promote critical thinking through an experience that connects technology with space exploration.

ÓRBITA approaches the search for Planet X as a scientific investigation without assuming that its existence has been confirmed. By encouraging the analysis of observations, the documentation of evidence, and the careful evaluation of potential anomalies, the project aims to demonstrate how astronomical data can support further investigations while respecting observational limitations and the need for additional evidence.
